name: The St. Regis Kanai Resort, Riviera Maya
insider_take: This ultra-luxe beachfront sanctuary sits on one of the Riviera Maya's most pristine stretches of white sand, where ancient Mayan cenotes meet contemporary Mexican elegance.
whats_special: The resort features Mexico's first St. Regis Butler Service and occupies a unique location in Kanai, a master-planned community that seamlessly blends luxury living with environmental conservation. The property showcases stunning architecture inspired by traditional Mayan design elements while offering direct access to the Mesoamerican Reef System, the second-largest coral reef in the world.
pro_tip: Book a cenote excursion through the concierge - the nearby Dos Ojos cenote system offers some of the clearest underwater cave diving in the world, and it's just 15 minutes away.
dont_miss: The signature St. Regis Sabering Ceremony at sunset, performed right on the beach with champagne and panoramic Caribbean views. Also explore the nearby Sian Ka'an Biosphere Reserve, a UNESCO World Heritage site home to jaguars, manatees, and over 300 bird species.
pros: Signature St. Regis Butler Service for personalized luxury experience
Pristine beachfront location on Riviera Maya's stunning coastline
World-class spa and wellness facilities with indigenous treatments
Multiple gourmet dining venues featuring international and local cuisine
Elegantly appointed suites with premium amenities and ocean views
cons: Secluded location may require transportation for off-resort activities
